notes: «رَوَى اَلْحَلَبِيُّ وَ أَبُو بَصِيرٍ وَ سَمَاعَةُ» : three co-transmitters at one level
«عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ» names the Imam inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator (owner ruling 2); the «قَالَ» that follows is his own speech
the Quranic verse is quoted by the report, not a transmitter
